# Nima Ghorbani

> Personal site of Nima Ghorbani, Head of Artificial Intelligence at Cubert Hyperspectral, Ulm,
> Germany. Computer vision, hyperspectral imaging, 3D human understanding and applied machine learning.

Sources of every page: https://github.com/nghorbani/nghorbani.github.io (Jekyll, al-folio theme).

(keep in sync with _bibliography/papers.bib)

- 2026-10-30: Speaking at the training course AI for spectral and hyperspectral data processing at Wageningen University & Research, 9 to 12 November 2026, Wageningen, the Netherlands. My lecture on 12 November: Cuvis.AI for RGB+: decisions beyond the visible.
